name: @Simple V Series Vol.1 - The Docodemo Gal Mahjong
summary: ＠SIMPLE Vシリーズ Vol.1 THE どこでもギャル麻雀 is a PlayStation Vita downloadable mahjong title developed by HuneX and published by D3 Publisher. The game features mahjong matches against AI‑controlled opponents with a cast of characters and a “Mahjong Island” mode where players earn in‑game currency by winning rounds to unlock items and reward content. Additional features include reward mini‑games, free match play, and collectible unlocks.
